summary: Anavex Life Sciences filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 20, 2026, disclosing a press release that provides a corporate and clinical update rather than a transactional event. The release reports completion of clinical conduct for two pharmacology studies of blarcamesine (ANAVEX 2-73) — an ADME and a DDI study in healthy volunteers — plus FDA clearance of an IND in Fragile X syndrome and a November FDA meeting on pediatric Rett syndrome enrollment. No price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is stated; no structural or deal mechanics apply. Watch for topline pharmacology data and FDA interactions as pipeline catalysts.
